title: A service can be booked with any of several team members, by turns or together

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21: a Space has one implicit host. Calendly round robin and collective events are its main team features, and Collective and Network plans sell to teams. Fix: service hosts (space_service_type_hosts), per-host hours, and assignment by turns or first free.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
